items.context: Should I start a new Stardew save that's a speed run of marrying everyone possible?
items.text: A themed save is a nice way to make Stardew feel fresh again. Keep a little list of everyone's favorite gifts nearby, you'll want it.

items.text: Congrats on the new coop. Something small and homey like Biscuit or Dumpling would suit a first chicken.
